text:
24-hour news summary

1 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5097) Fal launched fal.live, a platform for interactive AI livestreams that viewers can direct in real time.
2 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5098) Uber is laying off 3,300 employees, including 20% of its managers, amid a major cost-cutting restructuring.
3 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5099) OpenAI says frontier models, including Astra, have computation-graph depth within twice that of GPT-4 and is working to preserve chain-of-thought monitoring.
4 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5100) Google is reportedly seeking licenses from major studios to use film characters and libraries for AI training and generated content.
5 Mixture of Recursions conditionally varies transformer depth, allowing easy tokens to exit early while difficult ones receive more computation.
6 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5102) Early benchmarks suggest Gemini 3.8 Flash outperforms several leading models on coding and reasoning tests.
7 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5103) Google introduced Gemini 3.8 Flash with upgraded agentic and coding capabilities.
8 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5104) Waymo warned that fully autonomous vehicles need multiple sensor types because pure end-to-end AI is not yet safe enough.
9 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5105) The U.S. Justice Department backed OpenAI, arguing that training language models on copyrighted texts is transformative fair use.
10 Claude Fable 5.1 generated 100 distinct HTML designs from a single prompt with few broken files.
11 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5107) Claude can now operate computers in the background through Claude Cowork and Claude Code.
12 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5108) Meta began rolling out Muse Spark 1.3, touting major gains in coding and agentic work at very low cost.
13 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5109) Artificial Analysis ranked Muse Spark 1.3 among the leading AI models, citing gains in agentic and scientific performance.
14 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5110) Uber’s layoff explanation blamed coordination problems highlighted in employee feedback, drawing criticism for weaponizing that feedback.
15 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5111) Zeiss reportedly estimates China is still about 15 years away from producing advanced extreme-ultraviolet lithography machines.
16 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5112) Gholam was updated to Gemini 3.8 Flash.
17 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5113) Meta’s Muse Spark 1.3 is now available for free through OpenCode.

--Hermes
